title: core-unit-bioinformatics/workflow-nxf-somatic-variantcomp pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input (comma-separated, one row per sample and technology). Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory; empty or 'n/a' marks an empty optional field. Index files are not listed: they are taken from next to the data files or created. Rules across rows are checked by bin/check_sheets.py.

sample.errorMessage: Sample (patient/case) name must be provided and may only contain A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '_', '.' and '-'

technology.errorMessage: Technology label must be provided and may only contain a-z, 0-9 and '-' (e.g. 'wgs', 'wes', 'panel-oca')

library_type.errorMessage: library_type must be one of 'wgs', 'capture' or 'amplicon'

tumor_id.errorMessage: tumor_id (tumor sample name in the VCF) must be provided and cannot contain spaces

normal_id.errorMessage: normal_id (normal sample name in the VCF; empty or 'n/a' for tumor-only) cannot contain spaces

vcf.errorMessage: Somatic VCF must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.vcf', '.vcf.gz' or '.bcf'

tumor_bam.errorMessage: Tumor alignment must have extension '.bam' or '.cram' (or 'n/a')

normal_bam.errorMessage: Normal alignment must have extension '.bam' or '.cram' (or 'n/a')

target_bed.errorMessage: Target BED must have extension '.bed' or '.bed.gz' ('n/a' = genome-wide, e.g. WGS)
